_comment: v3.2 state file for the engineering-digest skill. Updated on the Issue 26 deliver (2026-09-18). Issue 26 was a USER-DIRECTED DEEP DIVE, 'Who Signs It Off' (AI operating model and the SDLC; spec v1.38; ~9,400 body words, 47 min, six inline SVGs). consecutive_non_deepdive reset to 0. Differentiated from Issue 23 (the five-stage adoption arc) by design: Issue 26 covers the organisational design - roles and decision rights (S2), the control layer of identity / execution boundary / policy at runtime (S3), lifecycle re-gating and what a trustworthy gate costs (S4), and what UK/EU regulated customers already require as evidence (S5) - with Lloyds Banking Group's Envoy platform and its four-year University of Glasgow study as the case study and a Counterpoint reconciling build-out numbers (Zalando 33% auto-approved, Figma 80% precision, DoorDash 130,000 tasks) against measured ones (Forrester under 10% team gain, Okta 34%, LinearB 32.7% acceptance). Cover lead stat 60% (Anthropic Agentic Coding Trends Report, 21 Jan 2026 - 'the collaboration paradox' is Anthropic's label); the 0-20% delegation figure could NOT be read in the primary and does not print. Meanwhile ran four items: Amodei 'We Must Pace the Frontier' (12 Sep) and OpenAI's misalignment-disclosure framework (16 Sep) as 'would have led'; CISA's three 16 Sep KEV additions and JDK 27 as 'also this week'. VERIFICATION: egress worked end to end (WebFetch and curl); every figure and quote traces to the section-briefs.md section 0.2 ledger (108 rows: 78 cleared, 9 softened, 21 dropped); seven of eight placeholder dates pinned; McKinsey (503) dropped and S2 runs with no published role inventory. Phase 5 FULL review FAILED first pass (epistemic reframing 13 vs cap 2; the 60% re-explained in S1; Section One-Five labels vs marker numbers in cross-references; a dropped Amodei-responses claim in Meanwhile; a 28-source breakdown summing to 24) - all fixed in the main loop with the reviewer's exact wording, plus ten secondary findings; re-review recorded in review.md Part 2. Binding corrections worth remembering: Salesforce's 15 Sep launch is AIforce (no 'AI Control Plane' / 'Agent Fabric' / 'Trusted Agent Identity' products exist); the 'policy is not governance until production can prove it' line is Bartolo's (InfoQ), not Microsoft's; feedforward/feedback is the Thoughtworks Radar's framing, Bockeler's is 'guides and sensors'; the CNCF post is a WSO2 member contribution and no control set was printed.
